c: Set the Configuration item to the thing that fails. Retired CIs aren't offered.
say: Set the configuration item to the thing that fails, such as a server or an application. Retired CIs aren't offered.

c: Set the Service and Service offering: what people can't use. Changing the service clears the offering.
say: Set the service and the offering: what people can't use. Changing the service clears the offering.

c: With no group yet, the CI fills it from its Support group (on a change, its Change Group).
say: If the ticket has no group yet, the CI fills it from its support group. On a change, from its change group.

c: On pdi2 few CIs have a support group and none a change group: set it yourself.
say: On pdi2 few CIs have a support group, and none has a change group, so check it and set it yourself.

c: The icons beside the field open the CI's map and its other open tickets.
say: The icons beside the field open the CI's map and its other open tickets.
